# PR #6804 — apply cross-family review findings (CHANGES_REQUESTED)

You authored PR #6804 (branch cursor/atlas-6711-wotd-hub-locale). The cross-family review verdict is CHANGES_REQUESTED with four findings — read them in the PR comment titled "Cross-family review of record" on https://github.com/learn-ukrainian/learn-ukrainian.github.io/pull/6804 and apply ALL four on the SAME branch:

1. Restore/fix the document title so УКР mode is not regressed to an English-only title (prefer the locale-aware mechanism #6750 used — titleKey via the layout — if it supports document titles; otherwise restore the prior title and say why).
2. The toggle test must assert actual per-locale visibility, not just span existence.
3. Add the escaping test for chromeDualHtml (lt, gt, ampersand, quotes → no injected nodes, exact text preserved).
4. Add behavioral watchdog-state tests (initial loading → success / failure → retry → watchdog fallback) for data-daily-loading.

Rules: work in your existing dispatch worktree for this branch; mutation-check new tests (each must fail if its guarded behavior is reverted); run cd site && npx tsc --noEmit && npx vitest run (scoped suites); push to the same branch (no new PR); comment on the PR summarizing fix-per-finding with quoted test evidence; do NOT merge / no auto-merge.

| Finding | Fix |
|---|---|
| 1. Document title | Restored `Слова дня / Words of the Day`. `titleKey` only drives the hero `<h1>`, not `<title>` (same as #6750). |

| 3. Escaping | New `chromeDualHtml` test for `<>&"` — entities in fragment, no injected nodes, exact text. |
| 4. Watchdog states | New `daily-loading.ts` + behavioral tests: loading → success/failure → retry → watchdog fallback. |
